activity.notes: Józef Piłsudski served as Poland's Chief of State (Naczelnik Państwa) from the decree of 22 November 1918 until he transferred authority to the first President, Gabriel Narutowicz, in December 1922. ATLAS uses the polity Poland rather than treating the constitutional phase 'Second Polish Republic' as a separate polity identity.

sources.title: Naczelnik Państwa — Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Poland
sources.citation_text: The Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs describes the 22 November 1918 decree establishing the office held by Piłsudski and its continuation until the first president assumed office in December 1922.

sources.title: Naczelnik — Muzeum Józefa Piłsudskiego w Sulejówku
sources.citation_text: The Józef Piłsudski Museum describes Piłsudski's service as Naczelnik Państwa and his transfer of authority to Gabriel Narutowicz in December 1922.
